name: On-device translation
meaning: Apps can translate with downloaded language packs. iOS 18 added the Translation framework; ML Kit offers the same on Android.

android.api_surface: ML Kit Translation, Gemini Nano via ML Kit GenAI

ios.note: iOS 26 adds Live Translation in Messages, FaceTime and Phone with AirPods.

limits.headline: Can translate text on your phone, after you download a language pack
limits.user_action: You tap Translate and choose the languages
can: Translate text into another language without the internet
Use packs of about 30 MB per language on Android
Translate calls and chats live with AirPods on iPhone (iOS 26)
cannot: Translate a language you have not downloaded yet
Send your text to a server just for this, since it works on the phone
Match every language on both platforms
limits.reach_label: Only the text you give it
limits.differs: iPhone shows a language pack sheet and has Live Translation in iOS 26. Android uses small language packs.

story.what_it_is: Translates text on the phone using downloaded language packs.

marketing.name: Translation framework
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps translate text on device with downloaded language packs.

marketing.name: ML Kit Translation
marketing.pitch: Google offers on device translation in ML Kit with small language packs.

story.for_you: You tap Translate and the text changes language, even in airplane mode. A language pack of about 30 MB is downloaded once.
story.for_makers: Makers add translation without server fees and keep text private. It helps global chat, travel and support.

use_cases.example: A tourist reads a menu in another language offline.
A chat translates a friend's message from Spanish.
A store app translates product reviews in real time.
A global game translates team chat between players.
A support agent reads a customer note in another language.
A video app translates captions as you watch.
A call translates speech live with earbuds in iOS 26.

story.android_note: Language packs are about 30 MB each.
story.ios_note: iOS 26 adds Live Translation in Messages, FaceTime and Phone.
